name: Royal Exhibition Building and Carlton Gardens
description: This grand Victorian exhibition hall stands in Melbourne's Carlton Gardens, on the northeastern edge of the city centre. Joseph Reed designed it for the international fairs of 1880 and 1888, blending Byzantine, Romanesque and Italian Renaissance styles in brick, timber and slate. Around it, 26 hectares of lawns, fountains, tree-lined avenues and Moreton Bay figs make a fine place for a picnic.
